newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Air Philippines to buy planes from United Airlines.
newsitem.headline: Air Philippines to buy planes from United Airlines.

text.p: Air Philippines Corp said on Thursday it started negotiations with United Airlines for the purchase of second-hand two Boeing 747 planes and two or three Airbus-300 planes.
Air Philippines president Peter Salud told a news conference the company may spend $15 million to $20 million for the purchase of a single 747-100 and $30 million to $40 million for an Airbus 300.
Salud said the 747s and Airbus 300s will be used for the company's proposed regional and international flights.
The negotiations for these planes started after Air Philippines announced last Sunday that it had agreed to buy 15 Boeing 737 jets from United Airlines over the next two years for $90 million.
Air Philippines "just concluded a five aircraft purchase agreement with United Airlines with all the planes to be delivered within the year", an Air Philippines statement issued last Sunday said.
"The first delivery is expected some time next week."
Ten more 737s will be bought from United and added to Air Philippines' fleet next year, the statement had said.
The new airline was formed by a group of Filipino businessmen and is based in the Subic free port near Manila.
It is one of three new domestic airlines that has sought approval to ply international routes.
